package assistance

import (
	"context"
	"errors"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

const finalizationPolicyVersion = "teacher-assistance-v1"

// TeacherEnsurer resolves the canonical logical teacher for a student.
type TeacherEnsurer interface {
	Execute(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error)
}

// Finalize converts teacher-owned decisions into one assistance summary after
// the student service closes an action cycle.
type Finalize struct {
	Teachers   TeacherEnsurer
	Decisions  repository.TeacherDecisionReader
	Assistance repository.LearningActionAssistanceFinalizer
	IDs        IDGenerator
	Clock      Clock
}

// Handle returns false only when the source event was already processed.
func (uc Finalize) Handle(ctx context.Context, input domain.LearningActionClosed) (bool, error) {
	if uc.Assistance == nil {
		return false, errors.New("learning action assistance finalizer is required")
	}
	closure, err := domain.NewLearningActionClosed(input)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if len(closure.LearningTargets) == 0 {
		return uc.Assistance.Finalize(ctx, closure, nil, nil)
	}
	if uc.Teachers == nil || uc.Decisions == nil || uc.IDs == nil || uc.Clock == nil {
		return false, errors.New("invalid finalize learning action assistance use case")
	}

	teacher, err := uc.Teachers.Execute(ctx, closure.StudentID)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	decisions, err := uc.Decisions.ListByLearningAction(ctx, closure.StudentID, closure.LearningActionID)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	supportContext, hintsUsed, maxHintLevel, interventionUsed := summarizeDecisions(decisions)
	observations := buildObservations(closure.LearningTargets, supportContext, hintsUsed > 0, interventionUsed)

	value, err := domain.NewLearningActionAssistance(domain.LearningActionAssistance{
		ID:                uc.IDs.NewID(),
		PersonalTeacherID: teacher.ID,
		StudentID:         closure.StudentID,
		CorrelationID:     closure.LearningActionID,
		CausationID:       closure.EventID,
		LearningActionID:  closure.LearningActionID,
		ContextType:       closure.ContextType,
		ContextID:         closure.ContextID,
		SupportContext:    supportContext,
		HintsUsed:         hintsUsed,
		MaxHintLevel:      maxHintLevel,
		InterventionUsed:  interventionUsed,
		Observations:      observations,
		PolicyVersion:     finalizationPolicyVersion,
		CreatedAt:         uc.Clock.Now(),
	})
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	event, err := domain.NewIntegrationEvent(
		uc.IDs.NewID(),
		domain.SubjectTeacherAssistanceObserved,
		value.CorrelationID,
		value.CausationID,
		value.StudentID,
		value.CreatedAt,
		domain.TeacherAssistanceObservedSchemaVersion,
		value.EventData(),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return uc.Assistance.Finalize(ctx, closure, &value, &event)
}

func summarizeDecisions(decisions []domain.TeacherDecision) (domain.TeacherSupportContext, int, *int, bool) {
	supportContext := domain.TeacherSupportIndependent
	hintsUsed := 0
	maximumHintLevel := -1
	interventionUsed := false
	for _, decision := range decisions {
		if decision.Action != domain.TeacherActionStaySilent {
			supportContext = domain.TeacherSupportGuided
		}
		if decision.Action == domain.TeacherActionGiveHint {
			hintsUsed++
			if decision.HintLevel != nil && *decision.HintLevel > maximumHintLevel {
				maximumHintLevel = *decision.HintLevel
			}
		}
		if decision.Action == domain.TeacherActionIntervene {
			interventionUsed = true
		}
	}
	if hintsUsed == 0 {
		return supportContext, 0, nil, interventionUsed
	}
	return supportContext, hintsUsed, &maximumHintLevel, interventionUsed
}

func buildObservations(
	targets []domain.LearningTargetRef,
	supportContext domain.TeacherSupportContext,
	hintUsed bool,
	interventionUsed bool,
) []domain.TeacherAssistanceObservation {
	perTarget := 1
	if hintUsed {
		perTarget++
	}
	if interventionUsed {
		perTarget++
	}
	observations := make([]domain.TeacherAssistanceObservation, 0, len(targets)*perTarget)
	for _, target := range targets {
		kind := domain.TeacherObservationIndependentContext
		if supportContext == domain.TeacherSupportGuided {
			kind = domain.TeacherObservationGuidedContext
		}
		observations = append(observations, domain.TeacherAssistanceObservation{Target: target, Kind: kind})
		if hintUsed {
			observations = append(observations, domain.TeacherAssistanceObservation{Target: target, Kind: domain.TeacherObservationHintUsed})
		}
		if interventionUsed {
			observations = append(observations, domain.TeacherAssistanceObservation{Target: target, Kind: domain.TeacherObservationIntervention})
		}
	}
	return observations
}
